name: VEIN
tagline: Native connector for a VEIN Linux dedicated server.
requirements: File access to the VEIN Linux dedicated server's Vein/Binaries/Linux folder

assets.label: Plugin
assets.hint: Copy libtakaro-vein.so and libsteam.so from the TakaroVein folder into Vein/Binaries/Linux, next to VeinServer-Linux-Test; no startup-line change is needed. The connector creates takaro.cfg there on the first start. The archive also holds licenses and the upgrade guide.
